<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: light;
  --background: 180 100% 25%;
  --foreground: 0 0% 0%;
  --card: 0 0% 75%;
  --card-foreground: 0 0% 0%;
  --popover: 0 0% 75%;
  --popover-foreground: 0 0% 0%;
  --muted: 0 0% 75%;
  --muted-foreground: 0 0% 0%;
  --accent: 0 0% 75%;
  --accent-foreground: 0 0% 0%;
  --border: 0 0% 50%;
  --input: 0 0% 50%;
  --ring: 0 0% 0%;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', 'Microsoft Sans Serif', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
  background: #008080;
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 420px;
}

.login-panel {
  position: relative;
  padding: 3px;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #c0c0c0;
  border: 2px solid;
  border-color: #dfdfdf #000000 #000000 #dfdfdf;
  box-shadow: inset -1px -1px #808080, inset 1px 1px #ffffff, 2px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type button {
  color: #ffffff;
}
.login-form {
  padding: 0 18px 18px;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.login-form::before {
  content: 'Sign In';
  display: block;
  margin: 0 -18px 18px;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, {{accentColor}} 0%, color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 40%, #1084d0) 100%);
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.login-panel::after {
  content: '✕';
  position: absolute;
  top: 6px;
  right: 6px;
  width: 18px;
  height: 16px;
  background: #c0c0c0;
  color: #000000;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 12px;
  text-align: center;
  border: 2px solid;
  border-color: #ffffff #000000 #000000 #ffffff;
  box-shadow: inset -1px -1px #808080, inset 1px 1px #dfdfdf;
}
.login-logo-box {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  height: auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #ffffff;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  overflow: visible;
}
.signin-methods [role='tablist'] {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: 0;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  flex: none !important;
  margin-bottom: -2px;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border: 2px solid;
  border-color: #ffffff #000000 transparent #ffffff;
  border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
  background: #c0c0c0 !important;
  color: #000000;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 400;
  box-shadow: inset -1px 0 #808080 !important;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  margin-top: -3px;
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  border-bottom-color: #c0c0c0;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #000000;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 30px;
  min-height: 30px;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #000000;
  font-size: 13px;
  border: 2px solid;
  border-color: #808080 #ffffff #ffffff #808080;
  box-shadow: inset 1px 1px #000000, inset -1px -1px #dfdfdf;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  outline: none;
  border: 2px solid;
  border-color: #808080 #ffffff #ffffff #808080;
  box-shadow: inset 1px 1px #000000, inset -1px -1px #dfdfdf;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  width: 15px;
  height: 15px;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #000000;
  border: 2px solid;
  border-color: #808080 #ffffff #ffffff #808080;
  box-shadow: inset 1px 1px #000000, inset -1px -1px #dfdfdf;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #000000;
}
.login-form a {
  color: #0000ee;
  font-weight: 400;
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.login-form .login-button-box {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  width: auto;
  min-width: 88px;
  height: 28px;
  min-height: 28px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #c0c0c0;
  color: #000000;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 400;
  outline: 1px solid #000000;
  outline-offset: 0;
  border: 2px solid;
  border-color: #ffffff #000000 #000000 #ffffff;
  box-shadow: inset -1px -1px #808080, inset 1px 1px #dfdfdf;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: #c0c0c0;
}
.login-form .login-button:active {
  border: 2px solid;
  border-color: #808080 #ffffff #ffffff #808080;
  box-shadow: inset 1px 1px #000000, inset -1px -1px #dfdfdf;
}
.login-form .login-signup-link {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  color: #000000;
}
#footer {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  height: 34px;
  padding: 0 10px 0 86px;
  border-top: 2px solid #ffffff;
  background: #c0c0c0;
  color: #000000;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px #dfdfdf;
}
#footer::before {
  content: '❖ Start';
  position: absolute;
  left: 4px;
  top: 4px;
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  background: #c0c0c0;
  color: #000000;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 20px;
  border: 2px solid;
  border-color: #ffffff #000000 #000000 #ffffff;
  box-shadow: inset -1px -1px #808080, inset 1px 1px #dfdfdf;
}
#footer > span {
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  border: 1px solid;
  border-color: #808080 #ffffff #ffffff #808080;
}
.login-content {
  padding-bottom: 64px;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
